Subtract 286 days from 1772-05-21.  
1772 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception).  
From 1772-05-21 back 21 days → 1772-04-30.  
Remaining 286 − 21 = 265 days earlier.  
Back 265 days from 1772-04-30:  
April has 30 days, so back 30 days → 1772-03-31.  
Remaining 265 − 30 = 235 days earlier.  
March has 31 days, back 31 → 1772-02-29 (leap year).  
Remaining 235 − 31 = 204 days earlier.  
Back 204 days from 1772-02-29:  
January has 31 days, back 31 → 1772-01-29.  
Remaining 204 − 31 = 173 days earlier.  
Now into 1771: December has 31 days, back 31 → 1771-12-29.  
Remaining 173 − 31 = 142 days earlier.  
Continue subtracting months backward through 1771.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 1771-08-09
